title: The 7th Guest black transition intervals
symptom: Three brief black intervals occur across the otherwise working post-title MPEG and gameplay handoff. The transition animation into the stairwell is visible, with a black interval both before and after it.
expected: Determine from hardware evidence which pauses or blank fields are authored/loading behavior and which, if any, replace missing transition imagery while preserving both post-title MPEG sequences and automatic gameplay entry.
revalidation_reason: The latest clean-NVRAM PAL/VMPEG GUI run completed the entire opening and clarified the observation: three black intervals are visible, and the animation turning into the gameplay stairwell plays between the latter two. Earlier evidence describing two wholly missing animations is superseded; real-hardware comparison is still needed before classifying the blank intervals.

input_events: manual click through pre-title launch clip

manual_verification.notes: Both post-title MPEGs and gameplay worked, but two hardware-reference transition animations appeared as black flashes.
With freshly cleared PAL/VMPEG NVRAM, both expected transition positions still flash black while the surrounding sequence plays.
The user confirmed that The 7th Guest plays as before when launched with blank ephemeral PAL/VMPEG player storage.

The full sequence proceeds. Three brief black intervals are visible in total. The transition animation turning into the gameplay stairwell is not missing: it plays between a black interval before it and another immediately before the stairwell gameplay frame. Whether any interval is an emulation defect remains unproven.
The user reports that The 7th Guest appears unchanged in the current multilingual/Photo CD regression build.
